body_html:
The Kate medium back armchair brings fashion to the workplace with sculpted seat and back cushions and a retro-inspired silhouette that reads as confident and current. Fully upholstered closed arms give it a finished, tailored presence that elevates any private office, meeting room, or reception area. Available in fabric, vinyl, or leather, it pairs polished design with the durability institutional spaces demand.

Features

  • Sculpted seat and back cushions with a contemporary, retro-inspired profile
  • Fully upholstered closed arms for distinctive style and lasting comfort
  • Four-legged guest armchair from the Kate seating series
  • Upholstered in fabric, vinyl, or leather to suit any palette (priced in Grade 1 fabric)
  • Exceeds ANSI/BIFMA standards, tested in an ISO 17025 certified facility
  • Backed by Global's commercial seating warranty — limited lifetime on the frame, base and mechanism, with five years on upholstery, foam and mesh

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 26.5"W x 26.5"D x 33.5"H, with an 18" seat height. Built in Canada by Global Furniture Group and part of a coordinating series that includes tilter, swivel, and ottoman models for a fully matched space.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, and an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Kate 2813 or call 1-800-835-9565.
